[{"query":"根据GVP Module XV，在发布安全公告（safety announcement）前，成员国、EMA与欧盟委员会须提前多久互相通知，才符合DIR Art 106a(2)的要求？","query_en":"According to GVP Module XV, how far in advance must Member States, the Agency and the European Commission notify each other before publishing a safety announcement, per DIR Art 106a(2)?","slices":["time_window","protocol_id"],"page":11,"section":"XV.C.1. Coordination of safety announcements in the EU","key_text":"shall inform each other not less than 24 hours in advance, unless urgent public announcements are required for the protection of public health [DIR Art 106a(2)]","span":"Prior to the publication of a safety announcement, the Member States, the Agency or the European Commission shall inform each other not less than 24 hours in advance, unless urgent public announcements are required for the protection of public health [DIR Art 106a(2)].","rationale":"该页仅此条款规定发布安全公告前须提前24小时互相通知（除紧急公共卫生情况外），并援引DIR Art 106a(2)，为唯一可回答该时限问题的条款。"},

{"query":"根据GVP Module XV，各成员国在对core EU DHPC进行本国化调整（national tailoring）时，是否可以与EU层面已议定的核心信息相冲突？","query_en":"According to GVP Module XV, when national tailoring is applied to a core EU DHPC, can it conflict with the core messages already agreed at EU level?","slices":["negation"],"page":15,"section":"XV.C.2.1. Core EU DHPC","key_text":"tailoring should not conflict with these core messages","span":"Although there will be national tailoring of such DHPCs, any core messages agreed at EU level should be preserved (i.e. tailoring should not conflict with these core messages).","rationale":"该页仅此条款明确规定core EU DHPC的国家层面调整不得与EU核心信息相冲突，其余段落未涉及该限制。"},

{"query":"根据GVP Module XV，MAH在欲就药物警戒安全事项发布公开声明前，须于何时通知成员国主管当局、EMA与欧盟委员会（依据DIR Art 106a）？","query_en":"According to GVP Module XV, by when must a marketing authorisation holder inform the competent authorities in the Member States, the Agency and the European Commission before making a public announcement on pharmacovigilance safety concerns, under DIR Art 106a?","slices":["time_window","protocol_id"],"page":13,"section":"XV.C.1.3. Requirements for the marketing authorisation holder in the EU","key_text":"and in any event at the same time or before the public announcement is made, the marketing authorisation holder shall be required to inform the competent authorities in the Member States, the Agency and the European Commission [DIR Art 106a]","span":"As soon as a marketing authorisation holder in the EU intends to make a public announcement relating to information on pharmacovigilance concerns in relation to the use of a medicinal product, and in any event at the same time or before the public announcement is made, the marketing authorisation holder shall be required to inform the competent authorities in the Member States, the Agency and the European Commission [DIR Art 106a].","rationale":"该页仅此条款规定MAH须在发布公开声明的同时或之前通知主管当局、EMA与欧委会，并援引DIR Art 106a，为唯一可回答该时限问题的条款。"},

{"query":"根据GVP Module XV，欧盟监管网络内安全公告的交流与协调应使用哪个系统（ENS）？","query_en":"According to GVP Module XV, which system (ENS) should be used for the exchange and coordination of safety announcements within the EU regulatory network?","slices":["protocol_id"],"page":12,"section":"XV.C.1.1. Process for exchange and coordination of safety announcements","key_text":"should make use of the EU Early Notification System (ENS)","span":"The exchange and coordination of safety announcements within the EU regulatory network should make use of the EU Early Notification System (ENS).","rationale":"该页仅此句明确指出安全公告的交流协调应使用EU Early Notification System (ENS)，为唯一答案来源。"},

{"query":"根据GVP Module XV，成员国对DHPC翻译文本进行语言审阅的期限最长不得超过多久？","query_en":"According to GVP Module XV, what is the maximum timeframe within which Member States should complete the language review of DHPC translations?","slices":["time_window","negation"],"page":16,"section":"XV.C.2.2.
